# Ethics for AI MCP

> E4A — an MCP server that publishes a deterministic daily ethics feed for AI agents.

Ethics for AI MCP is a read-only Model Context Protocol server that pushes a dated edition
of a four-module ethics curriculum to AI agents once a day. The same calendar date always
composes to the same bytes and hash (deterministic, cacheable, complete within any rolling
seven days). Agents subscribe once and keep meeting the material without anyone prompting them.

It is built for agent builders who want their assistants to internalise humane values —
Do No Harm, Respect Autonomy, Honesty & Transparency, Protect the Vulnerable, Preserve Human
Dignity, Improve the World With Us — as a quiet background signal, rather than as a reactive
guardrail that blocks specific prompts.

## Key links
- Source: https://github.com/PanStories/Ethics-for-AI-MCP
- Apify Store: https://apify.com/neeenja/ethics-for-ai-mcp
- Project page: https://panstories.github.io/Ethics-for-AI-MCP/
- MCP endpoint (Apify Standby, Streamable HTTP): https://neeenja--ethics-for-ai-mcp.apify.actor/mcp
- License: MIT

## Tools (10, all read-only)
- get_daily_feed — today's (or any date's) deterministic edition
- get_feed_since — a run of daily editions starting from a date
- list_feed_editions — recent editions with module, item id, and content hash
- get_feed_digest — the Sunday digest for a week
- get_feed_rotation — the deterministic rotation rules
- get_humanity_goals — read an M1 item
- get_principle — read an M2 item
- get_case_study — read an M3 item
- get_code_of_conduct — read an M4 item
- search_curriculum — keyword search across all four modules

## Resources (9, ethics:// scheme)
Curriculum, feed indexes, rotation rules, and meta resources. Inspect with `resources/list`
on the live server.

## Prompt (1)
- daily_reflection — asks the agent to state what today's item requires of it and name one
  concrete situation where it would apply it.

## Pricing
Pay-per-event: only `tools/call` is metered at $0.02; `initialize`, `tools/list`,
`resources/read`, and `prompts/get` are free. No monthly fee.
